ground_truth_provenance.details: Synthetic simulator truth is generated by v33_scenarios and raw endpoint truth; evidence is simulation_only and not real-world ground truth.

score_normalization.details: Task-priority weights are normalized over a shared paired obligation universe; no model-own-output denominator found. Raw cost components are persisted.

cost_accounting.details: Independent oracle and reviewer-written raw-event recomputation agree on audited valid labels; completed-task residual is skipped, unfinished residual is clipped weighted (1-progress), planner/safety CPU are separated, and initial replanning call is counted once.

pair_recomputation.details: All 34 audited committed shards validate labels and hashes; audited valid smoke/formal labels have no recomputation mismatch.

future_information_isolation.details: Two reviewer probes at t=0 and t=27 show different future tapes but identical public observations and selected actions; full receipts differ only in private event_tape_id provenance bindings.

focused_exactly_once.details: Independent reexecution of split/cooperate fixtures gives one report_generated and one report_received after logical completion, no additions under repeated NOOP, and rescue in oracle obligation set. Fixture captures paired state after rescue is already public and uses NOOP replan action; it does not cover split/cooperate occurring inside paired branches.

result_existence_and_real_calls.details: Committed shards, marker hashes, raw traces, oracle receipts, and planner receipts exist; runner calls candidate planning, label collection, and oracle validation.

scope_and_statistics.details: Current formal snapshot is 16/168 scenarios, all none_or_light (12 train + 4 validation), with 40 ordinary valid states and zero positive gains. Scenario-level aggregation is appropriate, but train has 4 contributing scenarios and validation 1; no model, gate, WM, or causal local/cross-region comparison is identified.

cross_region_analysis.details: Conclusion report's 771 candidates/98 selected and donor-transfer=120 are not semantically complete. Raw queue operations are insert=651, transfer=40, split=41, cooperate=39; 9 candidate and 9 selected actions contain cross-region dispatch without queue operations. Action-level totals are 780 candidates and 107 selected. Revise classification and counts before accepting cross-region claims.
